text:
sara_support: heads-up — ACME (acct_9876) escalated: sudden 429s and tail latency 502s after 00:00 UTC. They report X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0 on responses and spikes in queued latency. Can we confirm if this is tenant quota / burst exhaustion or routing fallback? Link: https://console.internal/tenants/acct_9876

alex_infra: looking. can you paste a sample request id or trace id?

sara_support: sample req id: req_20260317_5f3a ; trace: trace-0a1b2c. Customer says it started after they switched from redwood-13B -> redwood-7B-quant. No client config changes reported.

priya_prod: quick check — X-RateLimit-Remaining=0 strongly suggests tenant quota. I see a quota consumption alert for acct_9876 hitting 99% around 00:02 UTC. Query I ran: `SELECT tenant, sum(tokens) FROM requests WHERE tenant='acct_9876' AND time>now()-1h GROUP BY tenant;`

mike_sre: also correlate route-level 429s. run `curl -s "https://api.internal/metrics?query=rate_limit{tenant=\"acct_9876\"}"` or open /dashboards/limits/tenant-blame. note: 7B-quant can increase request rate since latency per request is lower — token throughput may spike.

sara_support: I pulled their top offending routes: /v1/generate (60%), /v1/chat (35%). Their client shows a ramp from 0 -> ~500 rps in <30s. Looks like an unthrottled burst.

alex_infra: are they Hosted or Dedicated? If Hosted, smart routing could've moved them to a node with stricter quota and autoscale/backpressure might return 429 + Remaining:0. i'll check the routing logs.

ops-bot: Incident INC-20260317-42 created and linked to tenant acct_9876 quota spike.

priya_prod: repro tip — simulate in staging with canary key: `ab -n 1000 -c 200 -p payload.json -H "Authorization: Bearer canary-acct_9876" https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`. Also inspect per-tenant token-bucket config: `redwoodctl describe quota acct_9876`.

mike_sre: for attribution run on telemetry: `SELECT route, model, tenant, count(*) FROM throttle_events WHERE tenant='acct_9876' AND time>now()-1h GROUP BY route,model,tenant;` That will show whether one model variant or route is causing most throttles.

sara_support: customer wants immediate mitigation — ask if we can do a temporary quota bump and recommend client-side backoff/jitter. assigning to @alex_infra for bump. :pray:

alex_infra: provisioning +20% burst window for 1h now. command: `redwoodctl quota update acct_9876 --burst=20% --expires-in=1h`. will post when effective. :white_check_mark:

priya_prod: i'll add a dashboard tile (per-tenant remaining tokens + 429 breakdown by route/model) and an alert to fire when remaining <5%. should help future attribution.

sara_support: thanks all — i'll confirm with ACME and close when they ack. adding suggested client mitigations: exponential backoff, jitter, reduce concurrency, and prefer lower-cost model for high-rate endpoints.
